chunks: [The blood of Uthman] And indeed, they are demanding a right which they have abandoned, and a blood that they have themselves shed,
If I were a partner with them in it, then they too have their share of it. But if they did it without me, then the consequence is only upon them,
And their greatest argument (against me) is really against themselves. They are suckling from a mother who is already dry, and bringing into life an innovation that is already dead.
How disappointing is this challenger! Who is this challenger and for what is he being responded to?
And I am pleased that the reasoning of Allah has been exhausted before them and He knows (all) about them.

key_terms.حُجَّةُ اللَّهِ: The reasoning or proof of Allah

ai.seo_question: What is Imam Ali's argument regarding the blood of Uthman?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) responds to the Qurra' (readers) who accused him of orchestrating Uthman's death, asserting that their claim of his complicity would make them partners in the guilt, but if he was merely the instrument, the primary responsibility rests with them. He critiques their superficial adherence to the Quran ('drinking from a mother who has weaned them') and their revival of a dead innovation, emphasizing that their own self-accusation serves as the ultimate proof against them. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that Ali’s caliphate was legitimate despite the political turmoil, and his satisfaction with Allah's 'hujjah' (proof) underscores divine justice in evaluating intentions versus actions.

en.sayed-ali-raza: They are demanding of me a right which they have abandoned, and a blood that they have themselves shed.
[1] If I were a partner with them in it then they too have their share of it. But if they did it without me they alone have to face the consequences.
Their biggest argument (against me) is (really) against themselves. They are suckling from a mother who is already dry, and bringing into life innovation that is already dead.
How disappointing is this challenger (to battle)? Who is this challenger and for what is he being responded to?
I am happy that the reasoning of Allāh has been exhausted before them and He knows (all) about them.
